form.label: Processes & Services
form.description: Running processes and systemd services per Linux host — Ubuntu boxes, the desktop client, the Proxmox host, and the containers. Collected by the UF (TA-dcloud-host). RBAC-scoped: you only see hosts in indexes your role can read.

search.query: index=* (sourcetype=linux:ps OR sourcetype=linux:services) | stats count by host | sort host

html.p: Pick a host (or All hosts) and optionally type a filter (e.g. postgres, apache, pve, ssh). Processes come from sourcetype=linux:ps (full snapshot every 60s); services from sourcetype=linux:services (systemd units every 5 min). No forwarder on a host yet? Install the UF: Ubuntu boxes install-uf.sh <site>, desktop install-uf-desktop.sh, Proxmox host install-uf-proxmox.sh.

search.query: index=* (sourcetype=linux:ps OR sourcetype=linux:services) host=$host$ | stats dc(host) as hosts
index=* sourcetype=linux:ps event=process host=$host$ | where _time >= relative_time(now(),"-3m") | stats dc(pid) as procs by host | stats sum(procs) as "Processes"
index=* sourcetype=linux:services event=service active=active sub=running host=$host$ | dedup host, unit | stats count as running_services

index=* sourcetype=linux:services event=service host=$host$ unit=*$filter$* | stats latest(active) as active latest(sub) as sub latest(desc) as description latest(_time) as t by host unit | where active="active" | eval "last seen"=strftime(t,"%F %T") | table host unit sub description "last seen" | sort host unit

index=* sourcetype=linux:services event=service host=$host$ unit=*$filter$* | stats latest(active) as active latest(sub) as sub latest(desc) as description by host unit | where active!="active" OR sub="failed" | table host unit active sub description | sort host unit

index=* sourcetype=linux:ps event=process host=$host$ comm=*$filter$* | stats latest(pcpu) as "CPU %" latest(pmem) as "Mem %" latest(rss_kb) as rss_kb latest(user) as user latest(ppid) as ppid latest(_time) as t by host comm pid | where t >= relative_time(now(),"-3m") | eval "RSS (MB)"=round(rss_kb/1024,1) | table host pid ppid user comm "CPU %" "Mem %" "RSS (MB)" | sort - "CPU %"

panel.title: Top processes by CPU over time — $host$

search.query: index=* sourcetype=linux:ps event=process host=$host$ comm=*$filter$* | timechart span=1m limit=8 useother=f avg(pcpu) by comm
